Images 1 and 2 are style references for the approved simple Kasa Jizō inline art: broad smooth colour areas, clear silhouettes, minimal surface detail. Image 3 is character and palette reference only for Riku and Chika; do not copy its detailed cover rendering. Show Riku and Chika finding and examining the stranger's bag at the sea wall. At midday in Shiomi, they crouch beside a small black shoulder bag between stone blocks. Riku has short dark hair, a pale grey shirt, dark shorts and black backpack; Chika has a dark ponytail, rust-orange top and light neutral skirt. Riku holds a small old photograph of a laughing man on a boat; Chika studies a plain notebook before slipping it into her pocket. Landscape 12:7, two teens grouped near the bag, calm harbour bands behind them. Flat broad colour planes, gentle clean contours, one or two simple shadows, very little texture. styleRefinements.sharedPrompt: Use case: style-transfer. Simple flat painted story illustration. Preserve the scene, people, clothing colours, poses, objects and wide composition. Match Kasa Jizō inline art with clean bold shapes, flat matte colour fills, smooth gently imperfect outlines and only one simple shadow shape per surface. Faces have tiny dark eyes and minimal nose and mouth marks; hair is a few solid shapes with no strands. Backgrounds use only a few large quiet blocks. Avoid gradients, grain, canvas texture, surface marks, fine fabric folds, hair strands, detailed boards, fine net mesh, fine foliage, tiny inventory, eye highlights, realistic detail, 3D lighting, extra story objects, text, border, logo or watermark.

jobs.addition: Reduce the harbour to broad bands of sky, sea, wall and island. Make the bag a simple silhouette, the photo one pale rectangle with a tiny figure, and the notebook a plain dark shape. Keep the circled mark faint and unreadable.

Reduce Tani's net to a loose grey shape crossed by only a few widely spaced lines. Turn the timber shed and harbour into simple blocks. Keep the three figures' clothing colours and paused-net gesture.
Make the tide table a simple grid with a few pencil strokes. Reduce shelves to three or four broad coloured blocks. Keep Riku, his aunt and the doorway ice box as the central shapes.
